definitions.explanation: An increase in wages or salary, typically negotiated between employers and employees or their unions.

examples.japanese: {賃上|ちんあ}げを{要求|ようきゅう}する。
{今年|ことし}の{春闘|しゅんとう}では{大幅|おおはば}な{賃上|ちんあ}げが{実現|じつげん}した。
examples.english: Significant wage increases were achieved in this year's spring labor negotiations.

examples.japanese: {物価|ぶっか}{上昇|じょうしょう}に{見合|みあ}った{賃上|ちんあ}げが{行|おこな}われなければ、{生活|せいかつ}は{苦|くる}しくなる{一方|いっぽう}だ。
examples.english: If wage increases that match rising prices are not implemented, life will only become harder.

notes:
{賃上|ちんあ}げ is a compound of {賃|ちん} (wages) and {上|あ}げ (raising). The opposite is {賃下|ちんさ}げ (wage cut).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {賃上|ちんあ}げを{要求|ようきゅう}する (demand a pay raise)
- {賃上|ちんあ}げ{交渉|こうしょう} (wage negotiations)
- {賃上|ちんあ}げ{率|りつ} (rate of wage increase)
- {大幅|おおはば}な{賃上|ちんあ}げ (substantial wage increase)

This word appears frequently in news about labor relations, especially during the annual {春闘|しゅんとう} (spring labor offensive), when Japanese unions negotiate wages with employers.
